text:
Anton Frondell, the third overall pick in 2025, is 19 and playing 17 minutes a night on the league's most difficult team to play for right now. He has 3 goals and 8 points in 18 games, with both goals in his last ten coming on one night in Boston, in what 9NEWS called his best NHL game. Since then he's gone four straight without a point and the chances have thinned out.

The five-on-five numbers are harsh: Chicago gets 36% of the expected goals with him on, six points worse than without him. Some of that is the company. Evolving-Hockey's small sample from his late-season debut last year had him with the weakest teammates in the league. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, nine games in, doesn't flag a strength or weakness yet.

For context, forwards picked first to fifth since 2005 had a median 0.54 points a game in their first full season, and nearly all reached 200 games. Watch his minutes: they've slipped by about two a night lately, and that's the first thing that has to turn.
headline: Anton Frondell is learning the hard way
